text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the campus, I came 
across a group of Umamusume gathered 
around the bulletin board...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, gather 'round! My 
masterpiece, the Feng Shui Newspaper! You 
gotta check it out!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! That's right! I want everyone 
to learn about feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I've been renting empty 
classrooms to hold Feng Shui lectures and 
such, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There weren't really many students, or 
rather... Hardly anyone knows about feng 
shui to begin with...
choice_data_list: So you were doing that sort of thing...
So you were doing that sort of thing...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And! I realized I've gotta make Feng Shui 
way more popular!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
To raise awareness, everyone needs to see 
it. And speaking of seeing things, the 
bulletin board newspaper! What do you 
think? Great idea, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, does this fortune-telling have 
anything to do with zodiac signs or blood 
types?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! This is called Nine Star Ki; you 
combine your birth year and birth month—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Kyusei...? (Nine Star Ki...?) Isn't that 
horoscope stuff?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
There's a lot of technical jargon... I 
might not really get it...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! There's Feng Shui you can 
put into practice starting today, too—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's all the commotion!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Rickey, going off on your own 
again...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Waah~ Wait, wait! I just want to cheer 
everyone on so they can give 100% of their 
hard work...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I told you not to put up posters without 
permission! In any case, the newspapers 
are confiscated! Come back after getting 
proper permission!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, I really did it now...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Permission is... well, that goes without 
saying. "Hard to understand," huh...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I made them think, "I don't 
really get feng shui," again.
choice_data_list:
The more you experience it, the deeper 
your understanding will become.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That's it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! Everyone's just not used to 
feng shui yet!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Things you see every day become second 
nature... If I take it step by step, I'm 
sure I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Alright, thanks Trainer! Rickey is feeling 
totally pumped and energized!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what should I do...? I kinda want 
to share more detailed info before putting 
up the newspaper..."
choice_data_list:
Like, using social media smartly or 
something?

Meet a senior who's been working 
diligently behind the scenes!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Social media! That is such a nice idea☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Jordan-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? You scared me... What's up? Did you 
come to tell me my lucky color again?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Including that, I think I'll post 
every day on social media!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Please teach me how to get everyone on 
social media to notice me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, like broadcasting to the whole 
world!? That sounds super fun! For now, 
gotta focus on visuals, and then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, Copano Rickey posted some 
stylish nail photos along with feng shui 
advice on her account. It seemed to get 
quite a bit of attention.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Speaking of steady grassroots work...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see, I seeâ If you want to connect 
with each and every fan, just leave it to 
Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get right to it! The birth 
of the Feng Shui Umadol Rickey-chan!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "H-Huh!? An Umadol!?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If you sing with a smile every day, 
everyone will watch you! ☆ Let's do some 
feng shui while we sing~! Alright!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see!? That might actually be fun in its 
own way...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she has started walking down a 
different path as well... At any rate, I 
decided to keep supporting her steady 
efforts.
